recap.paragraph: On Saturday, Nov. 28, Auburn visits Alabama! The Tigers are 7-4, and No. 6 Alabama is 9-2. Auburn’s Byrum Brown has 2,035 passing yards and 15 TDs. Alabama’s Keelon Russell has 2,480 passing yards and 21 TDs! This special game is the last regular-season game for both teams, with kickoff Saturday in Alabama.
